CustomField.description: Self-lookup to the item that must be completed before this one. Seeded at fan-out from Transaction_Task_Def__mdt: B3 points at B2, I8 points at I7, so the wire-fraud prerequisite is DATA, and adding a third pair later is a definition change rather than a deploy. A TRUE LOOKUP IS POSSIBLE HERE AND WAS NOT ON THE TASK MODEL: Lookup(Task) is undeployable on this org, which is why the Phase 0 gate on Activity had to store a Group plus Sequence text key instead. The cost is that fan-out needs a second pass to resolve Ids after the items are inserted. Blank means no prerequisite.
